name: subimage-mcp
description: Operator workflows over the SubImage MCP server: triage findings, investigate CVEs, audit IAM privilege, investigate containers and clusters, resolve IP/domain ownership, explain public exposure causes, review attack paths, audit SubImage coverage, build Cypher queries, author tenant-local custom rules, and identify Infrastructure-as-Code repositories.

interface.shortDescription: Operate SubImage through its MCP server.
interface.longDescription: Run repeatable SubImage workflows for findings triage, CVE investigation, IAM review, container and IP investigation, public exposure cause analysis, attack-path review, coverage audit, Cypher querying, custom rule authoring, and IaC repository identification.
